verdict.rationale: Crossmint's evidence covers how agents pay on a user's behalf: scoped agent cards via Visa VIC and Mastercard Agent Pay, delegated onchain signer keys, and x402/MPP payments. Nothing documents a merchant-facing way to verify agent identity, such as registered agent profiles, agent signatures merchants can check, or trust tiers that separate trusted agents from anonymous bots. The delegated signer key and network-rail credentials are payment authorization controls, so they are adjacent rather than agent identity verification for merchants.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots
